answers.core: Since making nodes visible only in the editor or running project is a relatively common operation in a polished game, it makes sense to have this as a core feature.
answers.workaround:
This can be worked around in at least two ways:

- Attaching a script to nodes that should only be displayed within the editor or running project.
- Using an autoloaded script by adding groups to nodes that should only be displayed within the editor or running project.

title: Add a property to make a node visible only in the editor or in the running project
